dhpak2.8:2.2: jetavane viharanto aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi.
dhpak2.8:3.1: So kira satthu santike yāva arahattā
dhpak2.8:4.3: araññaṃ ḍayhamānaṃ aggiṃ disvā ārammaṇaṃ gaṇhi –
dhpak2.8:4.4: “yathā ayaṃ aggi mahantāni ca khuddakāni ca upādānāni ḍahanto gacchati,
dhpak2.8:4.5: evaṃ ariyamaggañāṇaggināpi mahantāni ca khuddakāni ca saṃyojanāni ḍahantena gantabbaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
dhpak2.8:5.4: mahantānipi khuddakānipi upādānāni viya imesaṃ sattānaṃ abbhantare uppajjamānāni
dhpak2.8:5.5: aṇuṃthūlāni saṃyojanāni, tāni ñāṇagginā jhāpetvā abhabbuppattikāni kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti vatvā
dhpak2.8:5.6: obhāsaṃ vissajjetvā tassa bhikkhuno abhimukhe nisinno viya paññāyamāno
dhpak2.8:6.2: Saṃyojanaṃ aṇuṃ thūlaṃ, ḍahaṃ aggīva gacchatī”ti.
dhpak2.8:7.1: Tattha appamādaratoti appamāde rato abhirato, appamādena vītināmentoti attho. Pamāde bhayadassi vāti
dhpak2.8:7.2: nirayuppattiādikaṃ pamāde bhayaṃ bhayato passanto, tāsaṃ vā uppattīnaṃ mūlattā pamādaṃ bhayato passanto. Saṃyojananti
dhpak2.8:7.3: vaṭṭadukkhena saddhiṃ yojanaṃ bandhanaṃ pajānaṃ vaṭṭe osīdāpanasamatthaṃ dasavidhaṃ saṃyojanaṃ. Aṇuṃ thūlanti
dhpak2.8:7.4: mahantañca khuddakañca. Ḍahaṃ aggīva gacchatīti yathā ayaṃ aggī etaṃ mahantañca khuddakañca upādānaṃ ḍahantova gacchati.
dhpak2.8:7.5: Evameso appamādarato bhikkhu appamādādhigatena ñāṇagginā etaṃ saṃyojanaṃ ḍahanto abhabbuppattikaṃ karonto gacchatīti attho.
dhpak2.8:8.2: sabbasaṃyojanāni jhāpetvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ patvā
